teaser: Colby Moore investigates commercial satellite communications, reverse engineering Direct Sequence Spread Spectrum protocols using SDRs to intercept global telemetry.

title: Do Export Controls on Intrusion Software Threaten Vuln Research?

title: Drinking from LETHE: Exploiting Memory Corruption Vulns
teaser: Daniel Selifonov explores advanced memory corruption exploitation primitives, demonstrating deterministic heap layout manipulation and mitigation bypasses.

title: Docker, Docker Give Me The News: I Got A Bad Case Of Securing You

title: Quantum Computers vs Computer Security

title: Backdooring Git
